verdict.rationale: Booking an audit through a vetted auditor network is a fair question for a compliance-automation platform like Drata, so the axis applies. The pack only shows API endpoints to list and get audits ('List Audits ... Get Audit'). Nothing shows an auditor marketplace, an in-house audit arm, booking flow, or published timeline expectations, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder, I can book the audit itself through the vendor — a vetted auditor network or in-house audit arm with published expectations on timeline
